name: Anirban De
role: Making technology safer, simpler, and more trustworthy.
heroSummary: I'm a cybersecurity leader and engineer. I help companies protect their technology, manage risk, and use AI to solve complex problems.
about: For more than 14 years, I've helped teams tackle difficult technology and security problems. I believe the best security makes people's work easier, not harder. My focus is building practical tools, clear processes and better ways for organizations to make decisions.

achievements.title: Enterprise risk platform — Risk Central
achievements.context: Risk information was scattered across separate workflows, making priorities difficult to see.
achievements.action: Led work to centralize risk, issue, exception and control workflows in a shared platform.
achievements.impact: Created a more consistent way to assign ownership, prioritize risks and track decisions.

achievements.title: Reducing the security issue backlog
achievements.context: Security findings were difficult to prioritize and drive to closure.
achievements.action: Improved issue intake, prioritization, accountability and remediation workflows.
achievements.impact: 70% reduction in the security issue backlog and up to 3× faster remediation velocity, based on reported program results.

achievements.title: Automating compliance evidence
achievements.context: Repeated manual control checks and evidence collection slowed audits.
achievements.action: Built common-control and evidence automation workflows supporting programs including SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
achievements.impact: Reported 40% reduction in audit preparation effort.

achievements.title: Making access reviews less manual
achievements.context: Reviewing application access manually consumes owner time and can miss important changes.
achievements.action: Developing workflows to gather entitlements, route decisions to application owners and preserve evidence.
achievements.impact: Designed to reduce reviewer effort and improve accountability; measurable outcomes are still pending.

achievements.title: Third-party security intelligence
achievements.context: Large vendor ecosystems make it difficult to identify which relationships need attention.
achievements.action: Helped develop risk intelligence and assessment workflows to prioritize vendors.
achievements.impact: Supported security oversight across an ecosystem of more than 23,000 vendors.

achievements.title: Security exception governance
achievements.context: Teams need a structured way to manage temporary security trade-offs.
achievements.action: Developed exception request, review, approval and follow-up workflows.
achievements.impact: Improved visibility into decisions; related program work reported a 40% reduction in device-trust exceptions.
